final_rules: Freeze one quality-primary and at most one speed-secondary. FINAL never used for reselection. Unified head1 evaluated as separately bound engineering controls, not a new post-FINAL search.
primary_CHECK_ranking: Minimize the maximum of original-prompt Native minus candidate accuracy across GQA and VQAv2. Same-prompt Native remains a diagnostic control only; a worse Native prompt cannot make a candidate look better.
stage: Before any prompt-variant candidate has been generated
tie_rule: Within 0.25 pp worst-loss difference: measured E2E, then KV. Do not call near-equal point scores equivalence.
